objective: Compare request/user/event counts; verify the 299,572-trial illustration and insufficient-evidence warning.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
mode: bounded standalone fixed fictional teaching DATA ONLY
preconditions: Open the local index.html with scripting enabled; no server, framework, packages, account or subscription is required by the learner.
Use only nine fixed fictional profiles and four counting units. All counts, observations, outcomes, recovery records and assumptions are teaching data.
The metric is uninterrupted original transition journeys divided by all original started transition journeys, including interrupted and unknown outcomes.
actions: Compare REQUEST, USER, EVENT and JOURNEY counts
Select and inspect a fixed record and proposed denominator
Inspect original outcomes, rates, assumptions, confidence and warnings
Check an expected evidence conclusion as a teaching answer
Archive and reset controls without deleting retained evidence
assertions: REQUEST, USER and EVENT diagnostic totals are not interchangeable independent transition trials.
Numerically stable p_upper = -expm1(log(0.05)/n); ceil(log(0.05)/log1p(-0.00001)) is exactly 299572.
299571 fails the upper-probability threshold and 299572 passes, only under explicit independence, comparability and complete-observation assumptions.
Zero observed failures, successful requests, distinct users or a large aggregate count cannot certify five-nines or a real Azure SLA.
Interrupted and unknown started original outcomes remain in the denominator; later recovery is separate.
Unknown, dependent, incomparable, empty or observed-failure records receive no zero-failure upper bound.
Typed fixed-record, exact-shape, command-revision and canonical journal replay guards reject altered evidence before mutation.
History, keyboard, invalid-choice/error/reset UX, enforced CSP and exact capture opt-in are actually verified.
limits: No actual trial, load, telemetry, network, cloud, user-data, account, credentials, identity, infrastructure, scaffold, deployment or spending operations.
Large examples are fixed count summaries; no 299572 individual trials are generated or run.
No correlated effective sample size is invented; real correlation/cluster analysis and representative evidence remain native work.
No reliability pooling of repeated fixed exercises; in-memory replay guards do not establish durable/global authority across reloads.
Offline Playwright 1.56.1, signed Edge 156 and Node22 are local teaching tooling, not production Node24, native/source-parent proof or lifecycle-prototype qualification.
Only the parent can accept A-S149 once; B-S149 and D-S149 remain unverified, and tests/repairs/refinement earn zero extra credits.
